audit.whatIsWrong: FABRICATED ability name 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' used across 10+ full-layer fields — the real E is Subject: Torment. Content sub-spell mapping wrong in four places: 'QQ (Severing Bolt)' (Severing Bolt is QW; QQ is Devastating Fire), 'QE (Grim Visage)' (Grim Visage is EQ), 'EE (Stirring Sands)' (Stirring Lights is WE; EE is Crushing Maw), and 'EQ (Fleeting Current) knock-up' (Fleeting Current is WQ, a speed current, not a knock-up). breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad verbatim; W-shield-absorbs-burst interaction folded into cooldowns.
audit.why: Riot text in the brief lists the palettes: Q -> Devastating Fire/Severing Bolt/Molten Fissure; W -> Fleeting Current/Pool of Reflection/Stirring Lights; E -> Grim Visage/Gaze of the Abyss/Crushing Maw. E 12s-10s, W 18s-16s, Q 10s-6s, R 120s. Every Hwei spell carries the projectile flag — the reflect story here is bait-management, not projectile-vs-not.
